steps.title: Start with 2 panels
steps.instruction: Join 2 panels (A, B), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the GLADOM tray table. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (panel, about 53 cm), B (panel, about 53 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 53 cm tall.
In 8 assembly videos, people took about 28 seconds on this step. Take your time.
